## What Hello Trader Does

Hello Trader provides:
- Structured stock market education courses (technical analysis, equity, commodity, derivatives)
- 1-on-1 personalized batch mentorship
- A trading technology platform (Hello Trader Pro) for enrolled students
- Paper trading simulator with real-time market data (risk-free practice environment)
- Algo trading tools (strategy formulation, backtesting, automation)
- Copy trading tools
- AI-powered market analytics
- Option chain analytics
- Live trading terminal
- Market scanner

## Education Programs

1. Technical Analysis Course
   Fee: INR 8000 | Duration: 2 months
   Topics: Candlestick patterns, price action, support/resistance, live market execution, risk-reward

2. Equity Trading Course
   Fee: INR 12000 | Duration: 2 months
   Topics: Stock selection, intraday trading, swing trading, portfolio allocation

3. Commodity Market Course
   Fee: INR 15000 | Duration: 3 months
   Topics: MCX gold, silver, crude oil, global economic drivers, commodity cycles

4. Derivative Trading Course
   Fee: INR 24000 | Duration: 3 months
   Topics: Futures and options, option Greeks, option chains, hedging, volatility management

5. CFMT Program — Certified Financial Market Trader
   Fee: INR 54000 | Duration: 6 months
   Topics: All asset classes, algo trading, live market practice, 1-on-1 mentorship, lifetime community access

## Hello Trader Pro Platform

Available to enrolled students. Includes:
- Paper trading (simulated capital, real market data, risk-free)
- Algo trading (rule-based strategy automation and backtesting)
- Copy trading (explore and replicate trading strategies)
- Trading terminal (live charting, order book, execution interface)
- Market analysis (technical indicators, FII/DII data, sector momentum)
- Option chain analytics (Greeks analysis)
- AI-powered market tools (pattern recognition, sentiment analytics, scanner)
- Trader dashboard (P&L analytics, equity curve, trading journal)

## Important Disclaimers

- Hello Trader provides stock market education and technology tools for learning purposes.
- Paper trading uses simulated capital — results do not reflect real trading performance.
- Trading in financial markets involves risk of capital loss.
- Hello Trader does not provide financial advice or guaranteed trading signals.
- Educational content is intended to help learners understand markets, not to guarantee profits.
